correctness.rationale: Independent enumeration using the categorical adjacency relation recovered 196227 faces including the empty face, corroborated by cyclic column transfer. The vertex-order matching has 98087 pairs; a complete topological sort of the nonempty-face Hasse diagram processes 196226 faces and 1457216 incidences. The resulting Morse CW model has one 0-cell, 24 four-cells and 27 five-cells. Each signed reduction cancels a unit incidence in the direction of the acyclic matching. Independent reconstruction of the integral 24×27 boundary gave rank 21, a maximal minor of determinant −1 and 21 nonzero Smith factors all equal to 1. The homotopy inference does not rely on homology alone: the four-skeleton is a wedge of spheres and π₄ is identified with H₄ by Hurewicz. Attaching the five-cells gives the homotopy cofiber of a map of wedges of four-spheres specified by the degree matrix; unimodular basis changes are self-homotopy equivalences of the wedges. The cofiber of the Smith form is exactly the claimed wedge of three S⁴ and six S⁵.
residual_risks: This certifies only the stated categorical product, not other cycle lengths, color counts, or graph product conventions.
